plan.registration_amendment: Initial registration retained in initial_registration.json. After all initial replays, baseline verification compared in-memory swap-event tuples against JSON lists and rejected identical ledgers before saving. Only JSON-normalized verification and recoverable checkpoint saving were fixed; signal, exit, sizing, costs, windows, hypotheses and ranking are unchanged. Replays repeated under this source digest.

variants.sell_flat: SELL only: flatten at first quote at/after 23:55 broker time; BUY unchanged
variants.all_flat: BUY and SELL: flatten at first quote at/after 23:55 broker time

plan.entry_rule: Affected sides cannot enter 23:55 inclusive to midnight exclusive; otherwise original signals, sessions, cooldown and risk checks. No automatic reopening of a closed trade.
plan.fill_rule: First available M1 bar open at/after cutoff; actual bid/ask spread, commission and adverse market slippage. Never use a later quote to fabricate a prior fill. Quote gaps can cause late exits and real financing; daily protection has priority.
plan.selection: No parameter search, optimized cutoff or combinations. Run both predeclared hypotheses and baseline under both clocks, both cost levels and all three windows; report every result. Full stressed profit ranking is descriptive only, not untouched validation.
limitations: Reused historical dates; no untouched holdout or new strategy selection.
Current swap snapshot held constant over history; actual historical daily swap rates unavailable.
Broker midnight GMT+3 assumed, GMT+2 sensitivity; historical clock policy not established.
Observed spreads unchanged in stress; commission/slippage and negative swap debits doubled, credits unchanged.
Constant EUR tick valuation; margin, latency and tick extrema not reconstructed.
Swap booked before bar-open risk checks; entry at rollover exempt, exit at rollover before next bar exempt. Minute granularity.
EUR150 daily guard retained; paper aggregate exposure cap aligned to requested 0.75% per entry. Live config unchanged.
EUR100-200 winning-trade target is measured, never forced by increasing volume.

Five-minute deadline is a fixed execution convention, not an optimized parameter. Additional exits may discard winners and increase turnover. Rules are paper-only and not implemented in live execution.
